title: FGC 413: Compressed Natural Gas Motor Vehicle Fuel-Dispensing Facilities
officialText:
413.1 Applicability.

Motor fuel-dispensing facilities for CNG fuel shall be designed and operated in accordance with the New York City Fire Code.

413.2 Reserved.

413.3 Reserved.
